explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Transit: 108/120=90%; Campus: 153/180=85%; Residential: 240/300=80%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 90%.

distractorRationale.c: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 90%, 85%, 80%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
